scripts.quality:check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint:js && bun run lint:css && bun run format:check
scripts.quality:fix: bun run lint:js:fix && bun run lint:css:fix && bun run format
scripts.quality:full: bun run quality:check && bun run build && bun run test:a11y
scripts.lighthouse:ci: lhci autorun --url http://localhost:4321/ --url http://localhost:4321/blog/ --url http://localhost:4321/research/ --url http://localhost:4321/projects/ --url http://localhost:4321/notes/
scripts.perf:local: bun run build && bun run preview & wait-on http://localhost:4321 && bun run lighthouse; kill $!
scripts.perf:budget: bun run build && bun run preview & wait-on http://localhost:4321 && bun run lighthouse:ci; kill $!
scripts.a11y:ci: bunx pa11y-ci --config .pa11yci.json http://localhost:4321/ http://localhost:4321/blog/ http://localhost:4321/research/ http://localhost:4321/projects/ http://localhost:4321/notes/ http://localhost:4321/recipes/hokkaido-dinner-rolls/ http://localhost:4321/blog/2025/01-15-blog-post-features-template/
scripts.test:a11y: bun run build && bun run preview & wait-on http://localhost:4321 && bun run a11y:ci; kill $!
